notes: New: combined drawings lined up by grid. In File > New Sheet, choose Lined up by grid (or right-click a drawing with a confirmed grid > New Sheet Matching This Drawing). The drawings that split a floor are placed by their grid on a twin of the drawing they match, at the same paper size and scale, and cut where they meet. Move a cut by dragging it or with the arrow keys, make it follow a line drawn on either drawing, or show an overlap from one drawing. Each join shows how closely the drawings agree in mm. Pick Run, Find Text and Claude's tools read only what shows on the combined drawing.
